name: Precision Build
summary: Five deterministic skills covering the on-site half of AI discoverability. Contains no model layer at all - no provider, no prompts, no API surface - so determinism is a property of the package rather than of its configuration.

differs_from.B-coverage: No off-site discoverability skill, no semantic layer, no sentiment skill. Recommendation list capped at 8 and ranked by effort alone.
